patch.summary:
Choose Bitbucket Cloud only if your buying job matches “Atlassian git hosting — Free ≤5 users; Standard $3.65/user/mo (min 5-user equivalent); Pre” rather than Bright Data's shape. Choose Bright Data only if your buying job matches “Web data / proxy platform — pay-as-you-go from ~$4/GB residential; starter commitments fro” rather than Bitbucket Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage: Bitbucket Cloud leans source-control-devops; Bright Data leans web-data-collection. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Bitbucket Cloud is Atlassian git hosting — Free ≤5 users; Standard $3.65/user/mo (min 5-user equivalent); Premium $7.25/user/mo.; Bright Data is Web data / proxy platform — pay-as-you-go from ~$4/GB residential; starter commitments from ~$499/mo..
- Company-size focus: Bitbucket Cloud (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Bright Data (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bitbucket Cloud-leaning source-control-devops vs Bright Data-leaning web-data-collection.
- Researched limits: Bitbucket Cloud — Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams; Bright Data — GB/commitment pricing is opaque without live calculator — medium pricing confidence.

Limitations — Bitbucket Cloud: Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams; Ecosystem and Actions marketplace trail GitHub; Bright Data: GB/commitment pricing is opaque without live calculator — medium pricing confidence; Compliance and acceptable-use rules must be validated per project.
